name: "NAG" in output space (RT-RareTools)
plain: Named NAG and citing the NAG equations, but it runs on the model's whole denoised prediction, not on attention. It is CFG with an L1-norm cap and blend, done over the whole image.
math:
g = x̂_c·φ − x̂_n·(φ−1)
r = ‖g‖₁/(‖x̂_c‖₁+1e-7), over all non-batch dims
if r>τ: g ← g·‖x̂_c‖₁τ/(‖g‖₁+1e-7)
x̂ = α·g + (1−α)·x̂_c

props.extra_model_calls: 2 (RT_NAG_Guider), or 1 extra (model patch when no uncond is passed)

label: from code
surprise: No attention is involved. Same parameter names as KJ NAG but different math and cost.
